angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 285,237 km at 30.91 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 32.3545 +/- 0.0178 mas (same row, RUWE 1.26): 30.91 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.41 +/- 0.029 solar radii from Lacedelli et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-406 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract): 285,237 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.408 +/- 0.046 solar masses from Lacedelli et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-406 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3392 +/- 44 K from Lacedelli et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-406 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lacedelli et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-406 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-406.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.823, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-406 (pscomppars): spectral type M3, from Lacedelli et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-406 (pscomppars): [M/H] -0.02 dex, from Lacedelli et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-406 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.71444, from Lacedelli et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-406 (pscomppars): rotation period 29.2 d, from Lacedelli et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...692A.238L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
